assets.title: Recessed Token Dispenser Cabinet
assets.description: One original low-poly static token-dispenser cabinet exterior, counted as one complete prop. A narrow deep-teal housing has a genuinely recessed upper input slot with a closed back, a separate thick through-open metal bezel and one solid fixed rotary control. The lower receiver is a separate continuous thick scoop with a sloping inner floor, thick sides, a low front lip and a complete back, joined into a true cabinet alcove. A downward-facing deep blind neck opens above the empty receiver; it ends inside solid housing and is not connected to the input slot. A wide chamfered ground plinth, cream chamfered top and fixed closed rear service plate finish the cabinet.
